Today was no different, if anything - as he gave a few slow rolls of his hips into Mydei, he found himself hearing those tiny gasps along with Mydei’s delicious laugh so much more addicting than ever.

“That’s why you’re thrusting a little into me too, right?”

“It’s just to make sure all our hard work takes, I promise, Mydei.”

“I’m sure.”
